proof_dependency_chain: Construct U-small profinite covers of compact Hausdorff probes.
Identify profinite kification with compact-Hausdorff kification, preserving Hausdorffness and probes.
Recover natural transformations as continuous maps kX to kY.
Construct Hausdorff compact-open mapping space and kify it.
Prove currying by compact-domain and tube arguments.
Prove uncurrying by restricting evaluation to the compact image of a probe.
Translate the exponential law into all profinite mapping records and all Hausdorff parameter natural transformations.
boundary_checks: Author-identified temptation: Assume input spaces are already compactly generated.
Author-identified temptation: Assume compact-open evaluation is ordinarily continuous without local compactness.
Author-identified temptation: Replace k-products by ordinary products.
Author-identified temptation: Treat natural transformations as only originally continuous X-to-Y maps.
Author-identified temptation: Claim all Hausdorff realizations are homeomorphic from equality of probe records alone.
Independent peer check: The ultrafilter/profinite compact cover is U-small; compactness, unique limit, continuity and quotient property are proved, including the empty case.
Independent peer check: kification and all-probe natural transformation identification are valid; products are identified only after kification.

Independent peer check: Both directions of the k compact-open exponential law are complete; uncurrying restricts ordinary evaluation to the compact image of a probe and does not require local compactness of the whole source.
Independent peer check: The probe representation and evaluation-induced all-Hausdorff-parameter bijection are the exact requested maps, natural in parameters and X/Y continuous maps.
Independent peer check: Function spaces and topologies remain U-small; uniqueness is correctly restricted to kifications; empty cases are included.
Independent peer check: Fortissimo proves canonical function-map nonsurjectivity with ordinary evaluation, explicitly not an arbitrary-relabeling impossibility.
Independent peer check: The Q-to-R ordinary compact-open evaluation counterexample has a valid compact avoidance and positive-denominator continuous function.
